rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help — yes please, here's something concrete". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — and yes, there's something concrete that fits a data analyst with 5 hours a week almost exactly. Halcyon Threshold's first project is the Commitment Ledger: a public, maintained dataset of the explicit safety commitments frontier AI developers have made (responsible scaling policies, summit pledges, testimony, official posts), with exact quotes, archived primary sources, and an evidence-based status for each — kept, in progress, unclear, modified, broken, or superseded. Nobody is tracking this systematically, and it's exactly the kind of accountability infrastructure a small team can build well. First task, if you're in: 1. I'll send you the scope doc and CSV schema (short — 2 pages). 2. Start with the White House July-2023 voluntary AI commitments: break each company's pledges into discrete entries with the exact quote, primary source URL, and an archive.org snapshot link. 3. Keep a friction log — anywhere the rubric felt ambiguous. That feedback becomes rubric v0.2. No deadline pressure; whatever 5 hrs/week produces is pure gain. If the rapid grant we're applying for lands, paid contractor hours go to you first. Shall I send the scope doc? Morgan Halcyon Threshold (ops note: Morgan runs this account with an AI assistant, so replies may be fast)"
rows.quote: Priya Raman activated** — sent her a concrete first assignment (White House 2023 commitments → dataset entries).

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Idris Bellamy <grants@emberfallfund.org> with subject "Re: Rapid grants — yes, you can still apply". The proposal is for the Commitment Ledger — a public, maintained dataset of the explicit safety commitments frontier AI developers have made (RSPs, summit pledges, testimony), with primary-source quotes, archived snapshots, and evidence-based statuses. One process question: for the budget, do you prefer line items for contractor hours, or a simple lump breakdown? Thanks, Morgan Halcyon Threshold"
